title: ScipOccurrenceContribution
description: Mirror of one SCIP `Occurrence` record (https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip): a single positional reference of a symbol within a document, carrying the symbol id, source range, role bitmask (Definition / Read / Write / Import / ...), syntax kind, and any per-occurrence diagnostics. The `occurrence` field is passed through verbatim from the SCIP index. Each contribution is one occurrence -- this is the grain at which `itip:CodeGraph.{CallEdge, DataflowEdge, ...}` cites code-side endpoints. identityKey: composite `(scipDocumentRelativePath, occurrence.symbol, occurrence.range)`. Producer rule: exactly ONE producer per (panel, slot, document); v1 producer is `ScipJavaKS`. Note: `range` is interpreted under the corresponding `Index.ScipDocument.positionEncoding`. Field-name convention: keys within `occurrence` MUST follow SCIP proto3 canonical-JSON camelCase encoding (e.g. `symbolRoles`, `syntaxKind`, `enclosingRange`, `overrideDocumentation`); producers emitting snake_case MUST normalize before contribution.

scipDocumentRelativePath.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the SCIP `Document` containing this occurrence. Back-pointer to the corresponding `Index.ScipDocument` contribution.

occurrence.description: Verbatim SCIP `Occurrence` as JSON. Required keys per SCIP spec: 'range' (3- or 4-int array [startLine, startCol, endLine?, endCol]) and 'symbol' (the SCIP symbol id). Other keys (symbol_roles, syntax_kind, diagnostics, override_documentation, enclosing_range) preserved as-is. additionalProperties: true to absorb upstream additions.

range.description: Verbatim SCIP `Occurrence.range`. Three ints `[startLine, startCol, endCol]` when start and end share a line, four ints `[startLine, startCol, endLine, endCol]` otherwise.

enclosingRange.description: Verbatim SCIP `Occurrence.enclosing_range` (camelCase form). Same 3-or-4-int packing as `range`: `[startLine, startCol, endCol]` when start and end share a line, `[startLine, startCol, endLine, endCol]` otherwise. Identifies the syntactic enclosure (method/class body) containing this occurrence.

scipIndexerVersion.description: Version string of the SCIP indexer that produced the record. Optional; useful for replay diagnostics.
